676:t_2:3.en: ～ $$フロンティア船団$$ $$バトル・フロンティア$$ Bridge ～

676:t_2:4.en:
$$三島$$
「...Miss $$ストライカー#pilot$$ and the $$堕天翅$$ bought us plenty of time. Thanks to them, all preparations are complete.」

676:t_2:5.en:
$$三島$$
「All that remains is to show them the power of this $$クイーン・フロンティア$$, and of me, who commands it, and it will all be over.」

676:t_2:6.en:
$$三島$$
「No... it is not the end. It is the beginning of a new century!」

676:t_2:9.en:
$$三島$$
「What is this? Do you have some urgent report?」

676:t_2:11.en:
$$新統合軍兵$$
「You have outlived your usefulness.」

676:t_2:19.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「...So at last the whole of the $$フロンティア船団$$ will be ours.」

676:t_2:20.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Heh heh... Now that the fleet has already collapsed as a structure, I have no interest in it, though.」

676:t_2:21.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Still, how ridiculous $$レオン・三島$$ was.」

676:t_2:22.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「He outmaneuvered $$グレイス#pilot$$ and was acting like the complete victor.」

676:t_2:23.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「He seems never to have noticed, to the very end, that it was we who leaked her plan, as a trap to lull him into complacency.」

676:t_2:24.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「What will you do about $$グレイス#pilot$$?」

676:t_2:25.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Scrap her, for all I care. She's no longer needed.」

676:t_2:26.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「How pathetic. And after we worked so hard together to seize the galaxy.」

676:t_2:27.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「She changed. She spent too long in contact with the sample.」

676:t_2:28.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Why bother about someone who's already dead? Come on, let's head to the bridge.」

676:t_2:29.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Right. We can finally get out of this cramped place.」

676:t_2:30.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「From now on, all of the vast universe belongs to us.」

676:t_2:31.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Yes... For this form, with many minds made one, is the new shape of humanity that has attained $$シンカ$$.」

676:t_3:3.en: ～ $$ギャラクシー船団$$ Opera House Dressing Room ～

676:t_3:4.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...You really are a boy!」

676:t_3:6.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Y-your kabuki... it was wonderful. It really, really was... like a celestial maiden flying through the sky...!」

676:t_3:9.en:
$$矢三郎$$
「Thank you, young lady. But $$アルト$$ is still in training.」

676:t_3:12.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Someday I'll sing too, I promise! I'll make the galaxy tremble with my song, every bit as much as you do!」

676:t_3:17.en:
???
「...$$シェリル$$! Hang in there, please, $$シェリル$$!」

676:t_3:19.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Thank goodness! $$シェリル$$, you've been unconscious this whole time!」

676:t_3:20.en:
$$シェリル$$
「I was dreaming... A dream of a long time ago... a precious memory from my childhood...」

676:t_3:22.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...$$ランカ$$-chan... Looks like something good happened to you...」

676:t_3:24.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...It's all right. I still have my song.」

676:t_3:26.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Come on, let's go... Now is the time they need our songs.」

676:t_3:29.en:
$$エルモ$$
「With Island 1 in this state, how are we supposed to sing...!」

676:t_3:30.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「...You needn't... worry about that...」

676:t_3:33.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Sing, $$シェリル$$... I've activated the fold amp on the church stage...」
